claim_text: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore, a Democrat and military veteran, said on Sunday 16 August 2026 that President Trump's reaction to reported conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln angered him and should anger the public.
quote: The response of the president of the United States pisses me off. And it should piss all of us off
confidence_justification: Direct quotation of a sitting governor's on-record televised remarks.
